sentiment: We clear the walls that hide what matters, and find the view was always there — waiting for us to look.

stories.title: Kagi added a setting for removing paywalled links from search results
stories.summary: A search engine that lets you choose what gets through — sometimes the kindest thing is clearing the walls between people and the thing they were looking for.

stories.title: Rust Glancer: Rust LSP using 100x less RAM
stories.summary: Doing the same work with a hundredth of the weight — lightness is not less, it is everything unnecessary removed.

stories.title: There's no reason for software to be slow anymore
stories.summary: Speed without ceremony — proof that the obstacles we accept are mostly inherited, not required.
